baseline_models.focus_anchor: The chain سَيَّارَةٌ -> أَرْسَلُوا وَارِدَهُمْ -> أَدْلَىٰ دَلْوَهُ -> هَٰذَا غُلَامٌ -> بِضَاعَةً.
baseline_models.mechanism: A moving group delegates water access to one member; the lowered vessel unexpectedly returns a young person, and naming plus concealment converts that person into portable inventory. Travel, delegation, hydraulic retrieval, classification, and storage form one capture mechanism rather than separate events.

activation_trace.role: A traveling collective supplies the mobile network that can absorb and carry the find.
Dispatch releases a delegated agent from the group and initiates the retrieval sequence.
Arrival at a water source gives the delegate a concrete access function.
The verb-noun pair couples a well vessel with its operation, making the instrument the hinge between hidden depth and caravan space.
Youth is the first human classification assigned to what the vessel reveals.
A tradable portion of capital supplies the endpoint that recodes the retrieved youth as stock.

changed_reading.before: A caravan member happens to find a boy while drawing water and celebrates.
changed_reading.after: The ayah compresses a capture pipeline: a mobile network reaches into hidden depth, retrieves a person, assigns him a category, and incorporates him as movable stock.

baseline_models.focus_anchor: يَا بُشْرَىٰ هَٰذَا غُلَامٌ is voiced, while وَأَسَرُّوهُ بِضَاعَةً moves the same referent into secrecy.
baseline_models.mechanism: The visible encounter opens the face in joy and recognizes a human, but the inward decision cuts that human into a tradable share. Public exclamation and private valuation are not merely consecutive moods; they are two simultaneous interfaces to the same body.

activation_trace.role: The exposed human surface supplies the visible interface through which the find first registers.
Joy-opening news turns recognition into an audible positive reaction.
Concealment relocates the decision from voiced surface to controlled interior.
A severed portion supplies the conceptual cut by which a whole person can be treated as an alienable unit.
The commercial portion stabilizes that cut as inventory rather than a passing metaphor.

changed_reading.before: The good-news cry and the concealment are opposite reactions that follow one another.
changed_reading.after: The ayah stages a surface-interior split: visible humanity produces delight while private valuation simultaneously converts that humanity into a severable asset.

baseline_models.mechanism: Human actors create a secret commercial ledger, but the final clause places their purposive dealing inside a wider field of disclosure. Concealment controls other people, not the epistemic frame of the ayah.

activation_trace.role: Hidden interiority defines the limited human secrecy that the closing clause crosses.
Disclosure to a knower supplies a second register in which the concealed transaction is already open.
Purposive action makes the closing knowledge clause an audit of agency, not only of facts.
Interpersonal dealing gives the audited action a transactional and social scope.

changed_reading.before: The final clause is a general reminder of divine omniscience.
changed_reading.after: The final clause installs a counter-ledger over the secret trade: what the actors hide and transact remains disclosed as intentional dealing.

context_deltas.mechanism: The immediate sequel resolves the hidden merchandise into exchange, price, diminished valuation, and counting. This retrospectively gives the cry of joy an economic reading without cancelling genuine surprise at rescue.

activation_trace.role: Good news supplies the positive affect whose motive is reopened by the sale sequence.
Tradable capital makes the concealed classification operational in the next ayah.
Exchange converts the private inventory decision into an actual transfer.
Sale value places the retrieved person inside a pricing relation.
Diminution of due measure turns the find into an underpriced asset and exposes misvaluation.
Counting reduces the exchange to discrete units and completes the inventory logic.

structural_cues: The sale follows immediately after concealment and keeps the same person as grammatical object.
The branchless packet roots د ر ه م and ز ه د add cash denomination and low attachment.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies merchandise followed by exchange, price, diminution, and counting; I infer that the earlier joy includes recognition of economic opportunity. A live alternative is sincere rescue-joy followed by a later opportunistic decision.

changed_reading.before: The men rejoice at saving a boy and only incidentally decide to hide him.
changed_reading.after: Their joy can also register acquisition: concealment is inventory control before a deliberately low-valued sale.

context_deltas.mechanism: The commodity does not settle into one identity. The young captive becomes a possible child or owned dependent, then an empowered learner who reaches maturity, judgment, and knowledge. His low sale price and his latent role-value diverge sharply.

activation_trace.role: Youth supplies an unfinished identity capable of later development rather than a fixed market category.
Commercial stock provides the provisional shell whose inadequacy later roles expose.
A young child or owned dependent preserves the ambiguity between incorporation into kinship and continued possession.
Empowerment reverses the helpless object-status implied by secret merchandise.
Return to an outcome makes present classification answerable to a future that will disclose its inadequacy.
Reaching a limit converts the found youth into a temporal trajectory toward maturity.
Sound judgment supplies a future capacity that no sale price could measure.
Knowledge as disclosure makes the youth a future knower rather than only an object known and traded.

structural_cues: The buyer names benefit and adoption as alternatives; the narration then moves through emplacement, teaching, maturity, judgment, and knowledge.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a sequence of role changes; I infer that merchandise is a temporary external label around unpriced capacity. A live alternative is that adoption language remains possessive and does not yet undo captive status.

changed_reading.before: A found boy is converted into saleable inventory.
changed_reading.after: The found youth is a role-option whose identities coexist and compete: asset, possible child or dependent, empowered learner, and eventual judge.

context_deltas.mechanism: The first concealment begins a series of attempted enclosures. In the household, shut doors and solicitation again make the youth a privately controlled body, but speech, refuge, diversion, and purification reveal an agent who can resist the role imposed on him.

activation_trace.role: Initial concealment supplies the first human attempt to place the youth inside a controlled interior.
Commodity status gives that enclosure an externally assigned purpose.
Coercive closure turns secrecy into a bodily and spatial constraint.
The self or very person becomes the target, replacing commercial utility with intimate appropriation.
Seeking refuge supplies a counter-movement from imposed enclosure toward protection.
Turning away reverses the direction of solicitation and interrupts capture.
Escape from what has caught or entangled supplies the release-side of the containment pattern.

structural_cues: Multiple closed doors, direct speech, sight of proof, and the explicit turning away of harm make the later scene an enacted contest over control.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies concealment, coercive closure, a targeted self, refuge, diversion, and escape; I infer a repeated containment mechanism in which Joseph's agency becomes progressively visible. A live alternative is that the scenes are sequential dangers without a designed enclosure echo.

changed_reading.before: The caravan's concealment is a one-time precaution around valuable merchandise.
changed_reading.after: It is the first in a series of enclosures that try to assign Joseph a use; later resistance reveals the hidden commodity as a moral agent.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus closes with knowledge of concealed action; the later dispute gives hidden action a material direction. A lengthwise tear, the garment that bears it, its rear location, witness logic, and inspection turn an unseen event into a readable mark.

activation_trace.role: A distinguishing mark that guides supplies a latent forensic branch inside the focus claim of knowledge.
Intentional action is the hidden cause whose trace later becomes inspectable.
A long directional cut records force in damaged material.
The worn garment serves as the physical carrier of the directional mark.
The rear side supplies orientation from which pursuit rather than advance can be inferred.
A witnessing sign converts the damaged object into structured testimony.
Direct sight completes the move from hidden conduct to humanly inspected evidence.

structural_cues: The paired front/back conditions in 12:26-27 are followed by inspection and judgment in 12:28.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies a directional tear, its carrier, conditional alternatives, a witness, and inspection; I infer that material orientation mediates from action to knowledge. A live alternative is that the focus contrasts divine knowledge with later forensics rather than anticipating it.

changed_reading.before: God knows the concealed action while human beings simply lack access to it.
changed_reading.after: The knowledge-action hinge also opens a forensic reading: concealed conduct can leave a directional mark that humans inspect, even though their procedure remains vulnerable to power.

context_deltas.mechanism: An order to turn away from the matter fails to contain it: speech circulates through the city, Joseph is deliberately brought out for collective sight, and the observers negate ordinary humanity in favor of angelic classification. Hidden inventory becomes staged spectacle.

activation_trace.role: Concealment supplies the private state that later publicity reverses.
Human classification anchors the first declaration and becomes the category later explicitly denied.
Turning aside attempts to suppress attention and close the affair.
Speech circulating among people makes the secret socially mobile.
Public report and reputation show that concealment has become city-wide notice.
Bringing something out from hiddenness turns Joseph into a deliberately presented object of sight.
The human category returns under explicit negation, destabilizing the original label of boy.
Angelic classification supplies the elevated replacement produced by spectacle.

structural_cues: The sequence runs from suppression to city talk, invitation, staged exit, collective sight, and the explicit بشر/ملك contrast.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies failed suppression, spreading speech, staged appearance, and opposed classifications; I infer that secrecy increases the charge of later display. A live alternative is that the angel statement is only hyperbolic admiration and does not create a durable role.

changed_reading.before: Concealment keeps a valuable boy outside public knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Concealment incubates publicity: the boy is repeatedly recoded as merchandise, dependent youth, spectacle, not-human, and angelic rarity.

context_deltas.mechanism: The focus's knowing subject later hears a plea, answers it, and turns the scheme away. The counter-ledger therefore develops from disclosure into responsive counter-agency, though the response redirects danger rather than immediately restoring freedom.

activation_trace.role: Knowledge as disclosure establishes the divine awareness that later response makes active.
Answering speech converts awareness into a response to Joseph's appeal.
Sustaining correction gives the responder a formative role rather than that of a detached observer.
Turning away supplies the directional intervention that blocks the soliciting pressure.
Hearing sound makes the plea itself part of the responsive knowledge relation.
The repeated knowing branch closes the response with the same disclosure field introduced in the focus.

structural_cues: Joseph's conditional plea in 12:33 is immediately followed by response, diversion, and the paired divine predicates of hearing and knowing.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies plea, answer, diversion, hearing, and knowing; I infer a progression from epistemic witness to counter-action. A live alternative is that the answer operates through the lesser harm of prison rather than through direct release.

changed_reading.before: God's knowledge in 12:19 is an external audit of concealed human action.
changed_reading.after: That knowledge is also the opening of a responsive relation that hears, answers, and redirects coercive action.

context_deltas.mechanism: After signs have been seen, a new decision still emerges to confine Joseph for a fixed but open-ended interval. Evidence can disclose action, but disclosure does not compel a just action from those with power.

activation_trace.role: A guiding mark supplies the evidence model that the later decision tests.
Purposive action distinguishes what decision-makers do from what the signs allow them to know.
The appearance of a new opinion marks a discretionary turn after evidence rather than a deduction from it.
Actual sight removes ignorance as a sufficient explanation for the ensuing choice.
Visible signs supply the disclosed evidence that power can nevertheless override.
Confinement is the chosen action that contradicts the exculpatory force of the signs.
An assigned interval turns concealment into an institutional policy with controlled duration.

structural_cues: The sequence ثُمَّ ... مِنْ بَعْدِ مَا رَأَوُا الْآيَاتِ places imprisonment explicitly after sight of the signs.
context_deltas.reader_inference: The packet supplies seen signs followed by a fresh confinement decision; I infer that power knowingly overrides evidentiary direction. A live alternative is that the signs are broader than the torn garment and that imprisonment is framed as temporary damage control.

changed_reading.before: Once hidden action leaves a readable mark, human judgment can align with knowledge.
changed_reading.after: Readable signs can disclose truth without governing power; the focus's knowing-versus-doing distinction becomes accountability for action taken after knowledge.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is surprising because it uses a non-dominant split-root inventory for ج و ب to reactivate gathered-water and well-edge imagery at the moment of divine answer. It remains anchored in the focus's explicit water-approach and bucket mechanism, but downstream prose should present it only as a material echo, not as an alternate lexical translation of استجاب.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَارِدَهُمْ فَأَدْلَىٰ دَلْوَهُ makes water access and the well vessel the focus's central mechanism.

activation_trace.role: Water pooled in a depression gives arrival a branch-distant reservoir image at the opening of the scene.
Coming to water fixes the baseline action within an access-to-water domain.
The well vessel performs the first drawing that transfers Joseph between domains.
Gathered water supplies a remote material resonance inside the split inventory of the answering verb.
The space around well or basin closes the resonance back onto the focus setting and makes response resemble a counter-drawing.

changed_reading.before: The hydraulic imagery ends once the caravan draws Joseph from the hidden depth.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, the later answer reopens the water basin field: human drawing appropriates Joseph, while divine response counter-draws him away from coercion.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This reading is cross-domain because it links the commercial sense of a severed portion to literal cutting in the bodies of spectators. It remains anchored through بِضَاعَةً, the human-surface branch of ب ش ر, and the later hand-cutting scene; downstream prose should mark it as an image rhyme, not a causal prediction.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: The focus places visible humanity beside a word whose inventory includes both a cut portion and a commodity.

activation_trace.role: Exposed skin or surface makes bodily visibility part of the first joyful recognition.
A cut-off piece supplies the latent segmentation beneath the commercial label.
Literal severing externalizes segmentation in the spectators' response to seeing Joseph.
The bodily hand localizes the cut and prevents the activation from remaining purely commercial.
The negated human category joins visible body, commodity-piece, and cut body in one unstable classification field.

changed_reading.before: Calling Joseph merchandise is solely a legal-economic reclassification.
changed_reading.after: As an exploratory image rhyme, commercial segmentation of the human body returns as actual bodily cutting when the hidden asset becomes spectacle.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This activation is odd because it carries the disputed opposite-polarity branch of أَسَرُّوا, showing rather than hiding. It remains anchored in the exact focus root and the later arc from suppression to report and staged emergence; downstream prose should retain it as a concealment-display tension and must not replace the ordinary focus syntax with an assertive 'they displayed him' translation.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: وَأَسَرُّوهُ is the pivot between the voiced discovery and the commodity label.

activation_trace.role: The opposite-polarity display branch plants instability inside the focus's act of concealment.
Turning away supplies an explicit attempt to preserve suppression.
Circulating talk converts what should be suppressed into public social content.
Publicity makes the secret audible across the city.
Deliberate emergence from hiddenness realizes the display pole in action.

changed_reading.before: Concealment and later publicity are simply opposite phases.
changed_reading.after: Exploratorily, concealment already carries a latent display pole that the later scandal and staged appearance activate.

surprising_valid_outliers.containment: This is form-distant because it uses the non-dominant ق ل ل mapping attached to the focus occurrence of ق و ل. It remains worth carrying because the very next ayah supplies diminished value and counted units; downstream prose should describe a latent smallness-shadow under the exclamation, never claim that قَالَ lexically means 'small' here.
surprising_valid_outliers.focus_anchor: قَالَ يَا بُشْرَىٰ immediately precedes concealment as merchandise and the low counted price.

activation_trace.role: Smallness and paucity place a form-distant undertone beneath the voiced exclamation.
Joyful news supplies the bright surface against which the smallness undertone becomes surprising.
Sale value gives the latent smallness branch an immediate economic domain.
Diminished due measure concretely activates the undertone as undervaluation.
Discrete counting gives the low valuation a bounded, measurable form.

changed_reading.before: The good-news cry is affectively full and only later followed by a low price.
changed_reading.after: A contained split-root reading lets paucity shadow the cry itself: exuberant discovery is immediately compressed into small counted value.

strongest_changes: The water-retrieval episode becomes a capture pipeline that converts hidden personhood into mobile inventory.
The low counted sale activates an economic motive inside the cry of good news without eliminating rescue-joy.
Later roles expose the commodity label as provisional: child or dependent, learner, moral agent, witness-bearing body, spectacle, and prisoner coexist.
The torn garment activates a material-mark branch of knowledge, but the decision after seeing signs shows that evidence does not compel justice.
Divine knowing develops from a counter-ledger into hearing, answer, and directional counter-action.
summary.what_was_special: The focus ayah compresses hydraulic retrieval, visible humanity, secret commodification, and an epistemic counter-ledger. The context unfolds those compressed relations through sale, household incorporation, enclosure, forensic marking, publicity, reclassification, response, and knowingly imposed prison while preserving competing readings.
remaining_uncertainties: The initial joy may be rescue-joy, acquisition-joy, or both in rapid succession.
The repeated enclosure pattern may be a deliberate structural echo or only a recurrent condition of captivity.
The non-dominant split-root activations are diagnostic image resonances and should not control lexical translation.
The answered plea redirects harm through possible imprisonment, so counter-agency does not equal immediate liberation.
